caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a brownish rim, decorated with an intricate design in the center. The design consists of a stylized eagle with outstretched wings, grasping branches in its talons. Above the eagle, there is an ornate plant with large leaves, colored in shades of brown and yellow. The eagle's chest features a shield with vertical red and white stripes. Above the eagle's head, there is a semicircular arch with stars, and within this arch is the inscription "LIBERTY F. POLK." On either side of the eagle are the initials "F. G." to the left and "B." to the right. The plate features a circular band of text in a Gothic script style, written in black around the perimeter. Below the drawing of the plate, there is a semi-elliptical or shallow crescent shape filled with a flat reddish-brown color, resembling the side or base of the plate. The background is a plain, off-white color. The name "Aaron Fosterney" is handwritten below the drawn plate, slightly to the left.
title: Pa. German Plate
